name: Feyenoord Rotterdam

ucl_2026_27.qualified_via: Eredivisie 2025/26 runner-up (whether entry was direct or via qualifying rounds not verified)

identity.playing_style: Under Van Persie (2025/26) Feyenoord played an aggressive, front-foot 4-3-3 built around striker Ayase Ueda, who won the Eredivisie golden boot with 25 league goals; the side scored 70 but conceded 44 in 34 games, i.e. attack-heavy and defensively porous. Van Bronckhorst, appointed 17 June 2026 on a two-year deal, historically favours a more controlled possession 4-3-3 with wide wingers and a ball-playing pivot.
principles: recruit undervalued players from smaller leagues
identity.club_character: Working-class Rotterdam club with one of the most intense fan cultures in the Netherlands (De Kuip); expectation is to compete with PSV and Ajax every year; heavy media scrutiny nationally; second-best resourced club in the league.
identity.ownership: Foundation/association-controlled (Stichting Feyenoord holds the shares; no external majority owner)
identity.political_and_social_context: Publicly documented: recurring UEFA/KNVB sanctions and stadium-ban measures linked to supporter behaviour (fireworks, away-fan bans) in recent European seasons; long-running public debate over a new stadium (Feyenoord City) that was cancelled in 2022 in favour of renovating De Kuip. No further institution-level controversies verified for 2025/26.
identity.wage_structure: hierarchical but capped by Eredivisie economics; top earners well below Pot 1-2 clubs (exact figures unknown)
identity.transfer_policy: buy-low/sell-high; regular sales of best performers to Premier League/Serie A; reinvests in 20-25-year-olds; occasional experienced free agents (e.g. Jerry St. Juste Jan 2026, Raheem Sterling short-term Feb-Jun 2026)

last_season_2025_26.ucl_result: Did not play UCL (Europa League league phase; exit round not verified)

strengths: Elite Eredivisie goal threat: Ueda's 25 league goals (golden boot) and 70 team goals in 2025/26, second only to champions PSV.
Home advantage at De Kuip, historically one of the toughest away trips in Dutch/European football.
Stable, experienced coach who knows the club (Van Bronckhorst won the KNVB Cup 2016 and Eredivisie 2017 in his first spell).
Recruitment record of turning modest fees into big sales gives financial headroom.
weaknesses: 44 goals conceded in 34 league games (1.29/game) is too many for a title challenger and will be exposed against Pot 1-2 attacks (Barcelona, Inter).
Early KNVB Cup exit (round 2) and failure to keep pace with PSV (title decided 5 April) point to inconsistency.
Coaching change in June 2026 means a new system being installed while the Champions League starts.
Dependence on one striker for goals; loss/injury of Ueda would remove a large share of output.

positional_needs.profile: left-sided, quick, comfortable defending high line, 22-27
positional_needs.reason: 44 league goals conceded; St. Juste (29) is a stop-gap signing
over-reliance on Ueda for goals; Sterling's short-term deal has expired
